title: Green Salad X
description: A crisp, fresh salad of lettuce, sliced onion and ripe tomatoes, tossed with olive oil and a dusting of Ingredient X.

ingredients.item: Green leaf or romaine lettuce, torn

instructions: Wash and dry the lettuce well, then tear it into bite-size pieces and place in a large bowl.
Slice the tomatoes into wedges or thick rounds and the onion into thin half-moons.
Add the tomatoes and onion to the lettuce.
Drizzle with olive oil, sprinkle with Ingredient X and a pinch of salt, and toss gently.
Finish with a light drizzle of balsamic glaze if you like, and serve right away.

title: Foil-Packet Spicy Potatoes X
description: Crispy-edged, soft-centered potatoes sealed in foil with a generous coating of Ingredient X and a kick of crushed pepper.

ingredients.item: Baby or Yukon Gold potatoes, chopped

instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°F (220°C) or heat the grill to medium-high.
Chop the potatoes into bite-size pieces and toss with olive oil, Ingredient X, salt and crushed red pepper.
Pile onto a large sheet of aluminum foil, fold and seal the packet tightly.
Bake or grill for 35–40 minutes, opening the packet for the last 10 minutes to crisp the edges.
Finish with a light drizzle of balsamic glaze and serve hot.

title: Foil-Packet Spicy Onions X
description: Deeply golden, sweet and savory onions that make the perfect topping or side.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°F (200°C) or heat the grill to medium.
Slice the onions and coat them with olive oil and Ingredient X.
Wrap tightly in foil, leaving a little room for steam.
Cook for 30–40 minutes until deeply golden and sweet.
Use as a topping for burgers, steaks and sandwiches, or enjoy as a side.

title: Grilled Zucchini X
description: Thick planks of zucchini, charred and tender, dusted heavily with Ingredient X.
instructions: Heat the grill to medium-high.
Slice the zucchini into thick rounds or long planks.
Brush both sides with olive oil and dust heavily with Ingredient X.
Grill 3–4 minutes per side until charred and tender.
Finish with a drizzle of balsamic glaze if desired.

title: Sheet-Pan Chicken X
description: Crispy-skinned chicken thighs rubbed with Ingredient X and finished with a quick balsamic reduction.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°F (220°C).
Pat the chicken dry and rub all over with olive oil and Ingredient X.
Arrange skin-side up on a sheet pan and roast 35–45 minutes until crispy and 175°F (80°C) inside.
Meanwhile, simmer the balsamic vinegar for 6–8 minutes until syrupy.
Rest the chicken for 5 minutes, then drizzle with the reduction.

title: Roasted Cauliflower X
description: Thick cauliflower steaks, golden and caramelized, with a balsamic finish.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 450°F (230°C).
Cut the cauliflower into thick steaks, about 1 inch (2.5 cm).
Brush with olive oil and coat both sides with Ingredient X.
Roast 20–25 minutes, flipping once, until golden and caramelized.
Drizzle with balsamic glaze at the end.

title: Shrimp Skewers X
description: Fast, juicy shrimp seasoned with Ingredient X, grilled in minutes with a squeeze of lemon.
instructions: Heat the grill or broiler to high.
Toss the shrimp with olive oil and Ingredient X.
Thread onto skewers.
Grill or broil 2–3 minutes per side until pink and lightly charred.
Squeeze lemon over the top and add a touch of balsamic if desired.

title: French Fries / Wedges X
description: Ultra-crispy potato wedges or fries seasoned with Ingredient X, served with a balsamic-mayo dip.
instructions: Cut the potatoes into wedges or fries and soak in cold water for 20 minutes; dry thoroughly.
Toss with oil and Ingredient X.
Roast at 425°F (220°C) for 30–35 minutes, or air-fry at 400°F (200°C) for 18–22 minutes, shaking halfway, until ultra-crispy.
Stir the mayonnaise and balsamic glaze together for the dip.
Serve the fries hot with the dip.

title: Sausage & Veggie X
description: A one-pan roast of Italian sausage, zucchini, onion and bell pepper, tossed in Ingredient X.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°F (220°C).
Slice the sausage, zucchini, onion and bell peppers.
Toss everything with olive oil and Ingredient X on a large sheet pan.
Roast 25–30 minutes, stirring once, until the sausage is browned and the vegetables are soft.

title: Garlic Bread X
description: Thick, buttery slices toasted until golden and fragrant, with an optional balsamic brush.
instructions: Mix the softened butter with Ingredient X.
Spread thickly on the sliced bread.
Toast or broil 2–4 minutes until golden and fragrant.
Lightly brush with balsamic glaze if desired and serve warm.

title: Pasta Toss X
description: Hot pasta tossed with olive oil, Ingredient X and Parmesan, finished with a few drops of balsamic glaze.
instructions: Cook the pasta in well-salted water until al dente; reserve 1/4 cup of the pasta water.
Drain and toss the hot pasta with olive oil, Ingredient X and Parmesan.
Splash in pasta water to loosen into a glossy coating.
Finish with a few drops of balsamic glaze and fresh herbs if available.
